basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old dog lover from Portland, Oregon. I live with my partner and our beloved 7-year-old husky/lab mix. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to work flexible hours. I often spend my mornings and evenings online, typically browsing Reddit threads related to dogs, food safety, and history. I have a keen interest in understanding ancient civilizations, thanks to my minor in History during college. I love trying out new recipes and ensuring they are safe to consume, which is why 'foodsafety' is a recent interest of mine. In my free time, I enjoy listening to Cuarteto De Nos, a band I've recently discovered and can't get enough of.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid understanding of graphic design, which I pursued both in college and through self-teaching online courses. My interest in dogs stems from having grown up with several pets, and I regularly follow dog-care blogs and forums. My curiosity about history is both from formal education and personal reading.
